items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: Well, they weren't with them anymore.

ctx.x: Was this the same time that you were dancing that these people were with them?

Well, they weren't with them anymore. See, they finished that week at the 81 Theater. That was the finish of it, see, and they announced that they were going to marry. See, they were going to become husband and wife. See, they had been like partners for about seven years, you know, male and female partners, see, and that's the kind of act they did, see. And he -- Mr. Chinch Moore, he used to do these songs like That's Life, Pick Up the Pieces, I'm Busted, things like that, you see. And she would sing songs, you…
